problem_type: Repeated completion and implementation-detail narration in generation surfaces
symptom: Completed canvas nodes repeatedly show 已保存到项目, while Agent tool receipts expose bash as 运行命令.
direct_cause: The shared generation feedback projection synthesizes a success receipt from completedAt, and residentToolDisplay maps the low-level bash tool directly to a user-facing shell label.
class_root: Presentation surfaces lack a single invariant that terminal success is represented by the durable node/task state and that transport-level tool names are hidden behind user-facing intent.
affected_population: All completed generation nodes rendered on the canvas or timeline
All Agent panel turns containing the bash tool, in zh-CN or en
entry_points: Canvas and timeline consumers call generationFeedback for node status
Agent panel and approval receipts call readableToolName for tool labels
internal_only_reason: This is an internal presentation invariant; no third-party behavior determines it.
invariants: A successful terminal node has no transient inline saved receipt; task history and durable canvas state remain the completion evidence.
Agent-facing labels never expose the bash transport name or the phrase Run a command.

door_reduction.why_not: The canvas/timeline reader and task-center reader must remain separate because one is an inline live-status surface and the other is the durable task-history surface. Both now consume the same projection, while only the live projection suppresses terminal success narration.

generality_proof: Every canvas and timeline inline status reaches generationFeedback, so removing the terminal-success branch removes the duplicate across node variants and prerequisite-owned status. Every Agent tool label reaches readableToolName, so the bash mapping is hidden for all aliases and locales.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Owns the shared live-generation projection and fails closed to null for completed nodes.
Owns all Agent-facing tool labels and maps bash to the generic intent label.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All canvas node variants use this hook; completed success now returns null.
Task history intentionally retains a terminal outcome label for the completed row; it is not an inline duplicate on the canvas.
The Agent panel obtains labels through residentToolDisplay, whose bash branch now returns toolGeneric.

recurrence.reason: The duplicate was produced by shared projection code and applied to every completed node; the shell label was produced by a shared tool-name mapper and applied to every bash call.
same_class_scan: rg found all generationFeedback consumers in canvas, timeline, and task center.
rg found the only user-facing bash label branch in residentToolDisplay and both locale keys.
Targeted regression tests cover completion, lightweight nodes, page probe, and resident tool labels.

prevention.invariant: Terminal success is represented by durable state; transport names never become Agent-facing copy.
prevention.failure_mode: Completed nodes return no inline feedback, and bash resolves to the generic intent label.
prevention.strategy: Delete the terminal-success presentation branch and replace the transport-specific label at the shared mapping boundary.

removed_paths: generationFeedback saved window constants and fade branch
legacy_paths.rationale: The redundant saved-receipt path and its probe ledger are deleted in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls this presentation invariant.

migration: No persisted data changes; existing completed nodes continue to render from their durable media and task history.
residual_risks: A real Electron visual walk was not run in this worktree; the targeted render tests and syntax checks pass, but the final zh-CN/en screenshot evidence remains unverified.
